title: Megaliy International School Website
summary: This website is for a school and I had the privilege of working on some pages alongside a fellow full-stack developer.
body:
## What it does

Megaliy is a school website that I had the opportunity of working on certain pages alongside a full-stack developer. It is a fully functional school website with student management and teacher management, result generation and all .

## How I Contributed

I built all several pages by hand with HTML and CSS, without a framework, to get a solid understanding of layout before moving to React. The layouts use Flexbox, and a media query adapts them for phones. Vanilla JavaScript for the dynamic functionalities of the website.
